description.subtitle: Long pants of adidas tracksuits of Boca Junes Anniversary edition - blue
description.intro: The long adidas pants of Boca Juniors anniversary celebrates the 25 years of history of the bi-champion of America. Inspired by the xeneize tradition and designed for daily use, it combines a retro style with exclusive commemorative details that pay homage to the legacy of Boca Juniors. Its blue design with yellow details and the club shield make this garment an essential piece to show his passion for Boca.
key_benefits: Anniversary Edition: Special design commemorating the 25th anniversary of the American bi-champion.
Soft fabric: Provides comfort throughout the day.
Elastic waistband with cord: Comfortable and personalized fit.
Corte holgado: Favorece una gran libertad de movimiento.
Escudo oficial de Boca Juniors: Acabado de calidad para los aficionados del club.

Inspirada en la tradición xeneize y diseñada para el uso diario, combina un estilo retro con detalles conmemorativos exclusivos que rinden homenaje al legado de Boca Juniors. Su diseño en color azul con detalles amarillos y el escudo del club convierten esta prenda en una pieza imprescindible para mostrar su pasión por Boca.
